decision: R1655, R1657, R1658, R1659 and R1660 remain pending. OLDCB_DIR identifies the acquired input even when a hook changes the native message and pointer. The successful mapping flag prevents removal of a preexisting reference on failed acquisition. Clearing state before release also handles unwind. Restoring the original native-message switch alone selects the wrong cleanup; restoring it alongside the existing cleanup permits accidental deletion when a hook changes a different message to CB_DIR.
